posts.zh:
dsh-recall-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e9e4cd84d95a77a79340.html
posts.en:
dsh-recall-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e9e4cd84d95a77a79340.html
